data.key: Sorcerer Bonus Spell L5 ~ Major Creation
data.name: Major Creation
data.description: This spell functions like minor creation, except that you can also create an object of mineral nature: stone, crystal, metal, or the like. The duration of the created item varies with its relative hardness and rarity, as indicated on the following table. &nl;Hardness and Rarity &pipe; Examples Duration &nl;Vegetable matter &pipe; 2 hr./level &nl;Stone, crystal, base metals &pipe; 1 hr./level &nl;Precious metals &pipe; 20 min./level &nl;Gems &pipe; 10 min./level &nl;Rare metal* &pipe; 1 round/level &nl;* Includes adamantine, alchemical silver, and mithral. You can't use major creation to create a cold iron item.|PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell
